name: 19118 · Philadelphia, PA
findings: ZIP 19118 (Philadelphia) has 86 nonprofit organizations. 49 of them (57%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 45 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 19118 (Philadelphia) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 19118 (Philadelphia) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 28 organizations here; 30% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
